traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: On death: creatures within 5 ft make CON DC 11 or become Blinded for 1 minute; repeat the save at the end of each affected turn.

features.name: Captivating Artistry · 1/day
features.description: Action: one visible creature within 30 ft makes CHA DC 12 or becomes Charmed for 1 minute; repeat at the end of its turns. Record the daily use.

attacks.description: Medium or larger: use 2d4 + 1 Force instead.

traits.name: Relative Density
traits.description: Move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. Ending its turn inside an object deals 1d10 Force to the mascot.

features.name: Augment / Diminish
features.description: Bonus Action: change size by one category, up to Huge or down to 1 ft tall. Medium or larger grants Advantage on STR checks/saves; Tiny grants Advantage on attacks and DEX checks/saves. Record the size; Quantum Strike uses 2d4 + 1 at Medium or larger.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: Pass through openings as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

features.name: Ink Spray · 1/day
features.description: Action: one creature within 15 ft makes CON DC 12 or becomes Blinded until the end of the mascot's next turn. Record the daily use.

features.name: Shadow Stealth
features.description: In dim light or darkness, Hide as a Bonus Action.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: At the start of its turn, heal 5 HP if it has at least 1 HP. Fire damage suppresses this at the start of its next turn; record that exception.

traits.name: Spiny Hide
traits.description: At the start of its turn, deal 1d4 Piercing to each creature it grapples or that grapples it.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: At 0 HP: creatures within 5 ft make CON DC 12 or take 1d6 Radiant.

features.name: Counsel of the Past · 2/day
features.description: Action: touch a creature. Once within 10 minutes it may add 1d4 to an ability check immediately after its d20 roll. Record each daily use.
